CanCreate.description_en:
Indicates whether you can continue to create scan tasks. Valid values:

true: You can continue to create scan tasks.
false: You cannot continue to create scan tasks.

By default, up to 10 scan tasks can run concurrently. If the number of concurrent scan tasks exceeds 10, calls to this operation to create a scan task will fail. You must wait for at least one of the existing 10 scan tasks to complete before you can create a new scan task
CanCreate.description_zh:
是否可以继续创建扫描任务。取值：

true：可以继续创建扫描任务。
false：无法继续创建扫描任务。

默认支持同时存在10个扫描任务，超过10个扫描任务时，使用本接口创建扫描任务会失败。您需要等待已有的10个扫描任务中有扫描任务完成后，才可以继续创建新的扫描任务
